column1: NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO LAND PARCELS
Registration  of  Title Act, No.  21 of  1998

I
T is hereby notified that any person having a claim to the ownership or possession or interest to one or more of the parcels of lands
reflected in the Cadastral Map No. 950010 made by the Surveyor-General under Section 11 of the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of
1998  relating  to  the  village  of Kollapuliyankulam  (Block  01,  Sheet  No.  01)  or any  part thereof,  situated  within the  Grama  Niladhari
Division of No.225B - Mankulam in the Divisional Secretariat Division of Vavuniya North in the District of Vavuniya in the Province
of Nothern should submit his claim to the undersigned before 17th of October 2025 In the event of failure  to submit any claim before
the above-mentioned date, action will be taken to hold an ex parte inquiry to determine title to the land and accordingly publish such
determination in the Government Gazette in terms of Section 14 of the above Act.
